- GPU access (cloud compute: $500-2k/month can be substantial for experiments, but this isn't your constraint)
- A specific hypothesis you're testing
- Collaborators who can push back

Rather than solo setup:
- Could you get involved with an established group (Alignment Research Center, Redwood, etc.) part-time while keeping income?
